title: Cash-Flow Negative Week
app: Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Plaid-connected accounts, Plaid investments, and brokerage CSV exports ingested into Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=monarch:transaction
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(eval(if(amount_usd>0,amount_usd,0))) as inflow_usd, sum(eval(if(amount_usd<0,abs(amount_usd),0))) as outflow_usd by _time
| eval net_cashflow_usd=round(inflow_usd-outflow_usd,2)
| where net_cashflow_usd<0
| sort net_cashflow_usd
description: Uses Monarch transaction history telemetry to monitor weeks where cash outflow exceeded inflow in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for negative-cashflow stretches before they become a pattern, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Monarch transaction history data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors weeks where cash outflow exceeded inflow so you can spot negative-cashflow stretches before they become a pattern before it becomes annoying.
